semantics.train: Training engine operating sequences. Train and Test Unit IDs are split-local identifiers.
semantics.test: Partial test engine observations; the last observed cycle is not a failure cycle.
semantics.rul: Ground-truth remaining-life label at each Test Unit's last observed cycle, not a model prediction and not an original per-cycle sensor field.
semantics.rul_mapping: RUL file order maps to Test Units only after Test first-appearance order is verified equal to ascending Unit ID order and row counts match.
semantics.missing_policy: Do not fill, interpolate, delete, or rewrite. Structural missing values fail validation; quality issues are reported.
semantics.cycle_sorting: Ascending numeric cycle within one split and one unit.
semantics.unit_ordering: Ascending Unit ID for public interface results.
semantics.source_traceability: References identify source file SHA-256, physical line, 0-based data row, and 1-based source column.
semantics.validation_errors: Invalid width, numeric type, non-finite values, invalid keys, ambiguous RUL mapping, or source hash changes block validated use.

get_units.provenance: Unit IDs parsed from the selected source split.

get_cycles.provenance: Cycles parsed from rows matching the selected split and unit.

get_sensor_series.output: list[{cycle: integer, value: number, raw_reference: RawReference}] sorted by cycle
errors: ValueError for invalid split or sensor
get_sensor_series.provenance: Every point includes a raw source reference and no interpolation or smoothing.

errors: KeyError for invalid key or column
get_raw_reference.provenance: The implementation rereads the source token at the recorded physical line and column.

get_test_rul_label.provenance: RUL source row mapped by the verified Test Unit order convention; label applies only at the last observed Test cycle.

get_quality_summary.output: aggregate rows, columns, units, cycle lengths, missing, duplicates, statistics, and constant/near-constant flags
get_quality_summary.provenance: Aggregated directly from the selected validated split; population standard deviation uses ddof=0.

disclosure_boundary: Raw files, full raw indexes, and complete sensor series remain local and are not GitHub deliverables.
